title: Model Annealing: Data-Efficient Learning through Review and Consolidation
abstract: arXiv:2611.17524v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A small labelled dataset is memorized long before the training budget runs out, and the one-hot labels that remain to be fitted then mostly sharpen confidence. Model annealing spends the rest of the budget on review and consolidation, relearning from the network's own knowledge. Training is divided into episodes whose learning rate is raised again and cooled, every cooled state joins a memory of past selves, and each new episode learns from the labels, from the tempered predictions of this memory, and from adversarial dreams sought where student and memory disagree most. The memory averages predictions rather than weights, and the deployed network is the last student, so inference costs nothing extra. translated_title: 模型退火：通过复习与整合实现数据高效学习
translated_abstract: 在训练预算耗尽之前，小规模标记数据集早已被模型记住，而剩余待拟合的独热标签此时大多只是在进一步增强置信度。模型退火将剩余预算用于复习与整合，从网络自身的知识中重新学习。训练被划分为多个回合，每个回合的学习率重新升高后再冷却，每个冷却后的状态都会加入一个由过去自身组成的记忆库，每个新回合从标签、从该记忆的柔和化预测，以及从学生与记忆分歧最大处寻找的对抗性“梦境”中学习。该记忆对预测而非权重进行平均，部署的网络是最后一个学生，因此推理不产生额外开销。在CIFAR-100、Tiny-ImageNet和Imagewoof上，涵盖四种架构家族和5%到100%的标签比例，模型退火在33个配置中的28个里提升了使用AdamW训练的ConvNeXt、ViT和MLP-Mixer相对交叉熵训练的top-1准确率。
tldr: 模型退火通过将训练划分为学习率升降循环的多个回合、维护过去模型状态的预测记忆库，并从对抗性分歧和记忆预测中学习，实现了对网络自身知识的复习与整合，在数据受限场景下显著提升分类准确率且不增加推理开销。
en_tdlr: Model annealing improves data-efficient learning by cycling learning rates across episodes, maintaining a memory of past model states' tempered predictions, and learning from adversarial disagreements, achieving higher top-1 accuracy across multiple datasets and architectures without extra inference cost.
